description.value: Landmark Hot Pot House is a restaurant specializing in hot pot cuisine on Cambie Street in Vancouver. It features indoor seating and operates daily for dinner service, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal. The restaurant offers a communal dining experience where diners cook ingredients in a shared broth at their table.
